subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Tang Dynasty Tea Culture
description: A short lesson to help you apply Tang Dynasty Tea Culture.

hook.text: During the Tang Dynasty (618–907 AD), tea transformed from regional habit to national obsession.

buildup.text: Tea was compressed into bricks for transport along trade routes. Buyers shaved off pieces to brew.

discovery.text: The government imposed the first tea tax in 780 AD—proof that tea had become a major economic force.

twist.text: Tang-era tea was boiled with salt, ginger, and onion. It tasted nothing like modern tea.

climax.text: Tea spread along the Silk Road during the Tang era, reaching Tibet, Mongolia, and Central Asia.

punchline.text: A taxed, salted, brick-shaped drink conquered a dynasty.

quiz.question: How was tea transported during the Tang Dynasty?
options: As loose leaves in silk bags
